rationale: The agent initiated a return via a write action (return_delivered_order_items) without any visible confirmation from the user, violating the policy requirement to confirm before order-changing writes. Authentication is not evidenced beyond a lookup by email, and there’s no explicit linkage proving the order belonged to the authenticated user. The final message is a generic sign-off and does not provide outcome details (which items were returned vs. kept, refund method/timeline, or next steps). Therefore, the request was not completed in line with policy.
